ideas.pitch: A code documentation and bug-tracking tool that translates mundane stack traces and compiler errors into Gen-Z brainrot narratives, memes, and audio alerts.
ideas.title: Brainrot-to-Code: Gen-Z Slang-Driven Bug Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Targeted directly at the unconventional, Gen-Z culture of Tech-Melange '26 ('Come With Ideas, Leave With Bugs'), appealing to a younger, meme-literate judging panel.

ideas.pitch: An AI platform that analyzes short-form video trends to map out the rapid evolution and semantic meaning of modern Gen-Z internet slang.
ideas.title: SlangScribe: Gen-Z Short-Form Video Language & Trend Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages real-time video intelligence and aligns with the organizers' cultural branding and digital native focus.

ideas.pitch: An instant code audit tool specifically engineered to package security vulnerabilities and documentation gaps into clean, judge-ready 10-slide presentation decks.
ideas.title: AuditBrain: Automated Repository Security & Compliance Report Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the Round 1 requirement of submitting a comprehensive 10-slide PPT and project demo by automating the tedious documentation process.

ideas.pitch: An interactive web and computer vision app that gamifies local waste disposal using Gen-Z feedback loops and rewards.
ideas.title: EcoSlang: Gen-Z Gamified Waste Classification and Campus Impact Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines practical computer vision with a fun, unconventional interface that resonates with college festival audiences.

ideas.pitch: A machine learning dashboard that ingests a team's GitHub commit history and predicts the exact hour their codebase will completely crash before the submission deadline.
ideas.title: RiskCrash: Real-Time Hackathon Project Failure & Bug Predictor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Plays on the hackathon's tagline ('Come With Ideas, Leave With Bugs') with high self-referential humor that judges love.
